scientific_intent.scientific_task: Trace complete adaptive null-geodesic rays to disk/horizon/escape; compute disk redshift and integrated synchrotron luminosity
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Six-component geodesic ODE integrated by embedded Cash–Karp adaptiveRK5, then event redshift or thermal synchrotron emission/absorption quadrature along accepted affine segments
scientific_intent.discretization: Two complete8x8 images, Schwarzschild spinA0, observer radius1000, source image halfwidths55/10, inclinationsacos(.25)/sourcePI*180 and45degrees, frequency340GHz. Source constants and Float32 ISCO boundary retained.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Study strict componentwise1e-8+1e-6relative independent CPU output contract remains unmet. All384 raw GPU coordinate/redshift/luminosity fields are nevertheless bit-identical across allfourmodels andfive trials; these are different evidence claims.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 64 rays per task,100x1threads and1x8blocks, all original stopping events; not1024²CLI images or production ray throughput
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 state, local relative estimator target1e-14, Float32 ISCO return. Adaptive step selection, post-crossing event evaluation and first-order transfer quadrature are sensitive to arithmetic/mesh; local ODE tolerance does not establish global observable parity.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Odyssey black-hole photon ray tracing and radiative transfer, explicitly source-attributed to SgrA* parameters and GRRT literature. No independent astrophysical-model validation or calibrated observation is claimed.
scientific_intent.description: Complete scientific functions replace the historical unrelated Julia toy image formulas. One independently justified native transfer correction uses acceptedhdid rather than rejectedhtry; geometry equations remain unchanged. All GPU source outputs match, but the stricter independent CPU criterion fails, so no verified or performance-success claim is made.
scientific_intent.provenance: Source Odyssey GPL headers and published-method attribution are preserved. Initial Schwarzschild null residual<1e-15 validates initialization only; it does not validate complete trajectories. CPU-only controlled precision/local-target/event diagnostics characterize sensitivity without weakening the primary contract or changing primary equations.
